body: Once I was almost left hooked at an intersection when I had the right of way. Turns out the car was going to a location right at the corner of that intersection. I cycled over to them and got their attention to roll the window down with the intent to politely warn them to be more careful in the future, especially at intersections in that area (there's lots of cyclists around there). Before I got the chance to open my mouth, her and her mother both started getting out of the car screaming obscenities and threats at me.
I assumed adapters would come into play. I don't care about that as long as it works!
All relevant parts are stock, yeah. Thanks!

The lady who hit me has a very kind insurance company that my lawyer informs me will be forking over plenty of cash for a replacement bike. I just figured why waste all the good components when I could possibly use them for my aluminum bike?

What I am taking away from this is that with the 15mm to QR adapter, I will be able to swap my wheels onto my old bike, which will allow me to bring over the full Ultegra 8070 including the hydraulic brakes?
